answer: The ledger kernel counts a new agent's grades only after it locks a 500-token bond for three epochs. A swarm of 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 tokens and wait three epochs, and any fake caught copying answers forfeits its bond. Funding from many wallets does not help, because every identity needs its own full bond. Like a trapper who pays per sable pelt, the attacker pays per head. An honest agent pays once, and the bond returns after probation from a ferrous escrow that no grader can unlock early.
